reason: All V11/V12 stochastic residuals are projected to exact zero cube DC, while the frozen corrected conditional mean has a train/validation-stable source-dependent DC residual (about +0.026 in SIMBA development). A target-free scalar conditional-mean correction is therefore required before judging nonlinear density thresholds.

dc_model.form: ridge regression with an unpenalized intercept
dc_model.target: per-cube mean(truth - frozen V10-corrected conditional mean)
dc_model.selection: five-fold source-balanced train-only CV with fold-local feature scaling

application.conditional_mean: old conditional mean + predicted scalar DC
application.ensemble_member: old member + the identical predicted scalar DC

development_rule: Apply the one frozen train-only DC model to all six existing V12 development ensembles, evaluate with the eight unchanged field checks, and select the smallest of 2000/5000/10000 passing both TNG and SIMBA development.
postdevelopment_order: historical SIMBA CV0-15 stress field gate
sealed EAGLE confirmation32 field gate opened once

stop_rules.development_failure: stop without historical SIMBA or EAGLE
